authorityOrder: User preservation constraints and native source contract
Original model identity and palette family

immutableTechnicalConstraints.requirement: Preserve actual original asymmetric faceted slate mass, one-cell ground envelope and 0.48 height/proportions. Preserve fine shallow top fissure and its orientation with the model. No target-driven silhouette enlargement or replacement by a generic pebble.

Preserve exact registered camera/projection/pixel aspect, root, scale and frame. Capture is 384x704; logical frame [192,352], root [96,248], sourceScale 2, cellSize 128. No per-view fitting, cropping, stretching or recolor.
Render actual independent geometry at N/E/S/W for static frame 0; one frame per view, 12 fps metadata, static true, loop false. Supply four-view-sheet and repeated previews.
Use soft light with no preferred horizontal direction for the rotatable object and no directional ground cast shadow. Preserve clean real transparency.

Supply editable native Blender source, hash-bound packet, native camera/root/bounds/height/footprint/geometry/light evidence and declared resources. No raster card, image warping or painted render substitutions.

aestheticCriteria.success: The irregular broad crown, sloped perimeter and substantial side depth remain readable at the logical game scale. The asymmetrical original silhouette and uneven crown remain; small soft edge responses may improve tactility without smoothing away the source facets.
aestheticCriteria.reject: Round pebble silhouette, changed footprint/height, new platform, excessive inflated bevels, lost crown/side distinction, or new protruding chips.

aestheticCriteria.success: Dominant color remains subdued slate blue-gray. Gentle neutral-to-warm gray highlight variation gives the requested welcoming cartoon feel while still reading as the source slate material.
aestheticCriteria.reject: A beige/tan crown dominates, highly saturated blue, washed-out white patches, or near-black lower planes that merge into unreadable mass.

aestheticCriteria.success: Broad soft diffuse light reveals crown, side facets and lower edge without crushed shadows. Highlight response is restrained and matte; rotation reveals geometry while preserving the same soft tonal family.
aestheticCriteria.reject: A baked lateral spotlight, left-right directional rim, strong shiny streaks, blown crown, directional ground shadow or a dead black base band.

aestheticCriteria.success: A restrained, stable low-frequency variation helps the broad slate facets feel tactile and softly cartoon-rendered. The fine shallow fissure remains legible and attached to the crown, with visual weight close to its original identity.
aestheticCriteria.reject: Dense grain, glitter, stippled/painterly noise, arbitrary triangulation bands, deep or enlarged target-like slot, sharp white crack rim or apparent floating fissure.

aestheticCriteria.success: All four native views are clean at native and logical size against light, gray and dark backgrounds. No clipping, z-fighting, pinholes, halos, broken corners, disconnected crack, seam bands or muddy merged planes. Repeated placements retain consistent weight and style.
aestheticCriteria.reject: Any material defect or a view that only looks acceptable when enlarged; overlaid contact shadows or texture changes that do not follow the model.

rankedReviewOutcomes.outcome: Readable softly illuminated slate volume, especially lower side facets and base, in every required facing.
Subtle coherent tactile facet variation with soft restrained highlights and original slate-gray palette.
Original asymmetrical shape and fine crown fissure preserved cleanly at intended size, backed by exact native registration evidence.

targetDifferencesThatMayBeAccepted: Do not reproduce beige target recoloring.
Do not reproduce target silhouette/proportion drift.
Do not reproduce target deep widened fissure or noisy texture.
Unseen views should be coherent native rotations; the single-view target does not prescribe their surface pattern.
approvalBar: Visible improvement toward warm soft cartoon illumination/material treatment over the original in all four facings, all immutable contract checks passed, and no material visual defects. Missing required evidence yields needs_evidence; no numeric score alone earns approval.
